rows.text: Omega does not just tap creatures for a single turn. Its Wave Cannon trigger scales directly with the number of nonbasic lands you control and fires whenever Omega enters the battlefield. With thirty-six nonbasic lands in the ninety-nine, each entrance slaps eight to twelve stun counters onto each opponent's most critical nonland permanent while gaining you eight to twelve life. When paired with flicker engines and trigger doublers, Omega systematically freezes out opposing commanders, engines, and blockers for the remainder of the game while fueling game-ending Aetherflux Reservoir blasts.

Bracket 3: the Game Changer cap is three, filled by Cyclonic Rift, Field of the Dead, and Rhystic Study. No mass land denial. Infinite flicker combos (Deadeye Navigator plus Peregrine Drake, and Ghostly Flicker loops) wait until turn 6 under house rules.

rows.name: Omega, Heartless Evolution
rows.text: an 8/8 legendary artifact Robot. When it enters, tap up to one target nonland permanent each opponent controls, put X stun counters on each, and gain X life, where X is your nonbasic land count.

rows.name: Fear of Sleep Paralysis
rows.text: an enchantment creature that prevents opponents from removing stun counters from their permanents; permanents stunned by Omega can never untap as long as this remains on board.

rows.name: Verity Circle
rows.text: draws a card whenever an opponent's creature becomes tapped without attacking, turning every Omega trigger into multiple free card draws.

rows.name: Summon: Shiva
rows.text: taps down creatures with stun counters on early chapters, and Chapter III draws a card for each tapped creature your opponents control.

rows.name: Evolution Sage
rows.text: landfall proliferates, adding extra stun counters onto every tapped opposing threat whenever you play or ramp a land.

rows.name: Karn's Bastion
rows.text: utility nonbasic land that proliferates for {4} and {T} to keep opposing boards locked down.

guide.title: Infinite flicker and the lockdown finish

rows.name: Deadeye Navigator + Peregrine Drake
rows.text: soulbond Deadeye Navigator to Peregrine Drake; pay {1}{U} to flicker Drake, untapping five lands to generate infinite mana. Then soulbond Deadeye to Omega and flicker it infinitely to tap down every opposing nonland permanent with infinite stun counters and gain infinite life.

rows.name: Ghostly Flicker + Archaeomancer + Peregrine Drake
rows.text: cast Ghostly Flicker targeting Archaeomancer and Drake; Drake untaps five lands and Archaeomancer returns Ghostly Flicker to hand, netting infinite mana. Swap Drake for Omega to tap and freeze all opposing nonland permanents.

rows.name: Aetherflux Reservoir + Omega, Heartless Evolution
rows.text: repeated Omega Wave Cannon triggers generate enormous life totals, enabling Aetherflux Reservoir to fire 50-damage laser blasts to eliminate all opponents.

rows.name: Craterhoof Behemoth
rows.text: gives your board trample and massive power boosts based on creature count, easily swinging past frozen opposing blockers for a lethal combat finish.

Under Bracket 3 rules, the Deadeye Navigator and Peregrine Drake loop must wait until turn 6 or later. Use turns 1 through 5 to develop your nonbasic land base, cast Omega, and lock down the table's primary threats.

rows.name: Skyshroud Claim
rows.text: searches for up to two Forest cards (such as Tropical Island, Breeding Pool, Hedge Maze, or Tangled Islet) and puts them onto the battlefield untapped.

rows.name: Open the Way
rows.text: reveals cards until you hit up to four lands and puts them onto the battlefield tapped, heavily inflating your nonbasic land count for Omega.

rows.name: Farseek
rows.text: fetches a nonbasic dual land (Breeding Pool, Tropical Island, Hedge Maze, Rimewood Falls) to fix colors and count toward Wave Cannon.

rows.name: Nature's Lore + Three Visits
rows.text: one-mana-cheaper land tutors that search for a Forest dual land onto the battlefield untapped.

rows.name: Overlord of the Hauntwoods
rows.text: impending or hardcast creates an Everywhere land token, which counts as a nonbasic land for Omega.

rows.name: Spelunking
rows.text: draws a card and allows your lands to enter the battlefield untapped, letting lands from Open the Way or bounce lands enter active immediately.

rows.name: Dryad of the Ilysian Grove
rows.text: grants an extra land play each turn and lets your lands tap for all colors.

rows.name: Oracle of Mul Daya + Azusa, Lost but Seeking
rows.text: provide extra land drops per turn to quickly scale nonbasics and trigger Landfall engines.

rows.name: Aesi, Tyrant of Gyre Strait + Tatyova, Benthic Druid
rows.text: turn every land drop into card draw, keeping your hand full of interaction and flicker spells.

rows.name: Lotus Cobra + Tireless Provisioner
rows.text: produce mana and Treasures on land drops to accelerate into high-mana plays.

rows.name: Field of the Dead
rows.text: nonbasic land that generates 2/2 Zombie tokens whenever lands enter once you control seven differently named lands.

rows.name: Shifting Woodland
rows.text: delirium allows this nonbasic land to become a copy of Omega, Peregrine Drake, or Hullbreaker Horror from your graveyard.

rows.name: Talon Gates of Madara
rows.text: nonbasic land that phases out a creature upon entering, protecting your pieces or removing opposing blockers.

rows.name: Panharmonicon
rows.text: doubles Omega's Wave Cannon entrance trigger, tapping two permanents per opponent, doubling the stun counters, and doubling the life gain.

rows.name: Starfield Vocalist
rows.text: creature Panharmonicon that doubles any permanent-entrance trigger and features warp for a flexible setup.

rows.name: Roaming Throne
rows.text: name Robot, Leviathan, or Avatar to double Omega's Wave Cannon trigger every time it enters.

rows.name: Spark Double
rows.text: enters as a nonlegendary copy of Omega, triggering Wave Cannon and providing a second massive 9/9 body that does not die to the legend rule.

rows.name: Thassa, Deep-Dwelling
rows.text: exiles and returns Omega at each of your end steps, ensuring a free Wave Cannon trigger every turn cycle.

rows.name: Y'shtola Rhul
rows.text: flickers Omega at your end step and grants an additional end step, allowing a second flicker and Wave Cannon trigger in the same turn.

rows.name: Conjurer's Closet
rows.text: repeatable end-step flicker to lock down new threats.

rows.name: Displacer Kitten
rows.text: blinks Omega whenever you cast any noncreature spell, turning ramp and counterspells into immediate board freezes.

rows.name: Displace + Ghostly Flicker
rows.text: instant-speed multi-target blink spells to retrigger Omega and protect creatures from removal.

rows.name: Essence Flux + Planar Incision
rows.text: cheap one- and two-mana instant flickers to dodge removal while firing Wave Cannon.

rows.name: Blade of Selves
rows.text: gives Omega myriad when attacking, creating two token copies that each fire Wave Cannon to tap and freeze four additional opposing permanents.

rows.name: Cyclonic Rift
rows.text: premier one-sided board wipe; overload it at an opponent's end step to bounce all opposing nonland permanents and swing for the win.

rows.name: Mana Drain
rows.text: counters any spell and converts its mana cost into colorless mana on your next turn to power out Omega or high-cost engines.

rows.name: Counterspell
rows.text: clean two-mana stack interaction.

rows.name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
rows.text: one-mana negation for noncreature spells.

rows.name: Heroic Intervention
rows.text: protects your entire board with hexproof and indestructible against wipes and targeted removal.

rows.name: Beast Within
rows.text: flexible instant removal answering any permanent at the cost of a 3/3 Beast token.

rows.name: Reclamation Sage
rows.text: enters to destroy an artifact or enchantment, easily flickered by Displacer Kitten or Thassa.

rows.name: Eternal Witness
rows.text: recurs any card from your graveyard to your hand, creating an infinite flicker loop alongside Ghostly Flicker.

rows.name: Hullbreaker Horror
rows.text: uncounterable 7/8 flash threat that bounces spells and nonland permanents whenever you cast any spell.

rows.name: Lightning Greaves
rows.text: provides shroud and zero-cost haste to let Omega attack immediately or protect combo pieces.

rows.name: Rhystic Study + Mystic Remora
rows.text: relentless early card draw to find land ramp and protection pieces.

rows.name: Sylvan Library
rows.text: card selection and draw engine to stack your draws.

rows.name: Boseiju, Who Endures + Otawara, Soaring City
rows.text: uncounterable channel lands providing removal and bounce that bypass counterspells.

rows.name: Sink into Stupor
rows.text: MDFC answering a spell or nonland permanent, or played as an untapped land.

rows.name: Bala Ged Recovery
rows.text: MDFC that recurs any key card from graveyard, or played as a tapped land.

cards.name: Bala Ged Recovery // Bala Ged Sanctuary

rows.text: A winning hand contains two to three lands (preferably nonbasics), early mana acceleration (Sol Ring, Birds of Paradise, Delighted Halfling, Farseek, Nature's Lore), and an engine piece (Rhystic Study, Spelunking, Lotus Cobra, Sylvan Library).
Turn 1-2: Develop mana rocks and cast land ramp to build your nonbasic count.
Turn 3-4: Deploy value engines or trigger doublers (Panharmonicon, Starfield Vocalist, Roaming Throne). Ramp into six to seven mana with Skyshroud Claim or Open the Way.
Turn 5-6: Cast Omega, Heartless Evolution. Target each opponent's key threat, commander, or engine, burying them under six to ten stun counters and gaining six to ten life.

Turn 7+: Establish flicker engines (Thassa, Displacer Kitten, Y'shtola) or lock pieces (Fear of Sleep Paralysis). Assemble Deadeye Navigator + Peregrine Drake to freeze the entire table and fire Aetherflux Reservoir laser blasts, or overrun with Craterhoof Behemoth.
